text:
The Islanders come to Anaheim after a 5-2 win at LAK that ended a four-game winless run (0-2-2). They're still 1-2-2 in their last five, and they're missing Calum Ritchie and Alexander Romanov. The Ducks' five-game winning streak ended with a 4-2 loss to NSH, and they're without Ryan Poehling. Cutter Gauthier has absorbed some of those minutes, up to 19:22 a night from 16:42. NYI won the first meeting on Oct 20, 3-2, a game we thought they deserved 88% of the time.

Neither side is winning the chance battle at five on five: NYI has taken 48% of the expected goals (the quality of shots), ANA 45%. NYI's results are ahead of its chances, and goaltending is doing the lifting. Ilya Sorokin, projected in net, sits at 9.4 goals saved above expected this season and 22.3 last year. Lukas Dostal, also projected, is at -1.3 and -3.7. ANA's power play (0.77 expected goals a game) meets an NYI penalty kill that allows 0.90, and the Ducks take 5.1 penalties a game.

Gauthier has 14 goals in his last seven games and is 47% to score tonight. Bo Horvat plays his 900th NHL game, the ninth pick in 2013, and is 42% to score. Matthew Schaefer is 72% for a point. Our under-the-radar picks are both Islanders: Victor Eklund, whose third-line shots have been dangerous (3.2 expected goals in his last 10 games, 22% to score), and Schaefer, well above his season pace for a point.
